niche_preference_profile: Prefers light, neutral interfaces with soft purple or muted pastel accents, open spacing, and clearly structured information hierarchy. Favors calm, minimal, card-based layouts with subtle borders/shadows, integrated elements rather than floating overlays, and restrained emphasis in controls. Likes readable high-contrast text on light surfaces, labeled actions, and compact, organized data presentation over flashy, dark, dense, or icon-dominated designs.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds with dark text and soft purple, gray, pink, or pastel accents rather than dark navy/blue-black interfaces with neon or saturated accents.
Prefers strong hierarchy with clear section titles, labels, grouped content, aligned details, and well-separated blocks so information is easy to scan.
Prefers open spacing, fewer competing elements, simplified composition, and comfortable margins rather than dense, crowded, or cluttered layouts.
Prefers organized card-based or row-based layouts with balanced structure, integrated elements, and lighter visual weight rather than oversized graphics, floating overlays, or overlapping emphasis.
Prefers selective, subdued emphasis in buttons, toggles, and highlights, with calm primary actions and muted accent usage rather than highly prominent, flashy, or overly saturated controls.
Prefers soft elevated cards, subtle borders, thin separators, and little to no heavy shadow, avoiding bulky cards or strongly separated overlay containers.
Prefers text-labeled actions, clear status/frequency labels, readable comparison rows, and straightforward data displays over icon-only controls or less explicit visual indicators.
